title: Pathology plan sections render raw JSON objects; facilitator posts spurious Survey entry
wanted_capability: Object-aware rendering for diagnosis_summary/evidence/atom_mapping/remediation/deferred plan sections — pathology_markdown (src/workflow/ops/pathology_common.rs:348) renders non-string array items as `- {json}` backtick blobs, while contradictions/refuted already render nicely via pathology_findings_markdown. Either apply finding-style object rendering to those sections or constrain the facilitator Synthesize prompt to prose strings. Secondary polish: the facilitator (rust-architecture-pathologist) posts one whiteboard entry during Survey despite the prompt — harmless to the gate (it checks lens aliases) but pollutes the board and gets validated.
notes: Extracted from thread-cc07f395 items 3+6 during thread triage. Rendering behavior re-verified in code 2026-06-11.
resolution_note: Primary ask fixed (2026-07-14, beta/blackbox-v2): pathology_markdown's object-item arm now renders every field as readable key-value prose (**key**: value; nested structures stay compact JSON per-field) instead of one backtick JSON blob, so diagnosis_summary / evidence / atom_mapping / remediation / deferred sections get legible bullets — lossless, deterministic (BTree key order), no key heuristics. Regression test pathology_markdown_renders_object_items_as_prose_not_json_blobs. The secondary polish item (facilitator posting a spurious Survey whiteboard entry) is a prompt-discipline nit, harmless to the lens-alias gate, and per the gap's either/or framing is subsumed by the rendering fix.
